reason: The real Node producer and conditional logging mechanism were demonstrated, but the campaign requires a justified actual workload and material performance evidence before publishing an optimization. Neither the ordinary CLI volume with a used disabled-Error filter nor credible whole-operation materiality is established. Do not manufacture these with repeated callbacks, longer output, a persistent Node loop or the RecordingLogger queue.

acceptedExistingBoundary.producer: Actual Node process.stderr through NodeScriptRunner and EventedStreamReader; not injected events.

perRole.disabledRows: Critical and None each fail the expected attempted-log assertion without the guard and pass with it.
perRole.enabledControls: Information and Error pass in both variants.
perRole.redGreenEvidence: test-rows.json; red-green-row-proof.json; underlying native TRX and command records.

acceptedExistingBoundary.limit: Correctness of the fixture mechanism only, not a complete npm/Angular/React CLI workflow, incidence, throughput, latency, allocation or worthwhile performance improvement.

unmetPerformancePrerequisites: Natural developer CLI scenario and ordinary stderr volume with an actually used Critical/None filter; no negative prevalence claim is made.
A defensible material whole-operation effect; startup dominance is only an unmeasured risk, not a no-gain finding.
Actual loaded Original and separate Default CLR/image observations, exact Node/host witnesses and four sealed complete execution images.
Qualified existing-project consumer and coordinator-reviewed executable protocol;203 is a source-only proposal, not authority.
dispositionLimits: This is not a false-positive finding, measured no-gain result or claim that the private guard is useless.
The enabled-path IsEnabled cost remains unmeasured.
Inherited tiering0 helper configuration was not accepted as representative or executed for this finding.
The193 RecordingLogger is not approved as a timed consumer.
Stateful filters and exceptional callbacks were not exhaustively validated.
The decision is bounded to current evidence, not a prohibition on future evidence-backed work.

authority.finalization: Only after complete evidence packaging and remotely verified fork-only publication; no ledger change by this decision artifact.
